{{Quote|Ikas-Adno has been in the speeder market for centuries, and the 88-R Nightscreamer might be the best thing their craftserfs have ever knocked together.|Chentu Chek, ''Tools of the Trade'', a chapter from ''Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
The '''88-R Nightscreamer''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]]. In contributing a chapter to the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'', [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chentu Chek]] recommended the 88-R Nightscreamer as a high-end speeder bike option. Chek felt that the Nightscreamer was Ikas-Adno's best product due to its speed, [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shield]], and the availability of aftermarket packages.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Its top speed is a suicidal 750kph, and it generates a forward-facing particle shield that deflects wind and grit&hellip;|Chentu Chek, ''Tools of the Trade'', a chapter from ''Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
The 88-R Nightscreamer was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by the manufacturing company [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] that sold for at least 11,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. With a maximum speed of 750 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]], it had a forward-facing [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shield]] that protected the rider from wind and sand, and could also nudge the vehicle away from glancing collisions. A standard aftermarket package was available that added low-slung twin [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and a rear-mounted [[shrapnel cloud emitter]] to avoid pursuit. A [[side-car]] could also be installed on the speeder bike to accommodate a passenger or extra cargo.<ref name="BHC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Punch that shrapnel cloud when you've got a baddie glued to your tail, and I swear you'll never again underestimate the effect of metal fragments in the face.|Chentu Chek, ''Tools of the Trade'', a chapter from ''Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], which marked the end of the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]],<ref name="Era">According to ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', [[Chentu Chek]] knew the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], who was active during the [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]] and [[Rebellion era]]s. Additionally, the book contains an opening letter by [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], who states the book includes "overviews of trade tools" that were "recently introduced to the market." According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Cradossk [[Death/Legends|died]] at the conclusion of the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]], which occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Taken together, these facts indicate that the 88-R Nightscreamer was in use during one or both of the aforementioned eras.</ref> the veteran [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chentu Chek]] recommended the 88-R Nightscreamer as a high-end speeder bike in the chapter ''Tools of the Trade'', which was published in the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''. In Chek's opinion, the Nightscreamer was the best product that Ikas-Adno had produced during the manufacturer's previous [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] due to its shield, availability of aftermarket packages, and a top speed that he described as suicidal.<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 88-R Nightscreamer was introduced in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a reference book released in [[2013]]. The book was co-written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BHC" />
